name: Forge 1
description: Incendiaire du Jugement déclenchant des conflagrations incontrôlables dans les rangs adverses ravageant les positions fortifiées.

subject.archetype: Forge 1 — Héritiers des cendres Epic class radiation

loadout.armor_outfit: Armor forged from melted debris and volcanic slag, dark metal plates held by thermal bonds glowing orange at every seam, heat distortion rising from every surface, scorch marks and soot coating every inch forged from rare materials with faction crest embedded and energy pulsing through the entire surface with every movement
loadout.arsenal: Dual flame projector gauntlets superheated to molten temperatures dripping liquid fire, volcanic glass blade still glowing cherry red at core, ash grenades on belt radiating heat The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's death ability targeting enemy_on_capture, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Being captured but reaching back with final curse, focused targeted dark energy flowing from captured body into captor's position as vengeful last act before being taken
attitude.emotion: Apocalyptic fury — full weight of faction's power channeling through body uncontrollably

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Ember Orange
palette_names.role: primary_accent — flames, energy blasts and burning particles

palette_names.name: Magma Yellow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — lava flows and inner core glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing light along border edges, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Wide dramatic low angle showing full blast radius, character backlit by their own power source, foreground devastated by ability effects

scenography.setting: Volcanic battlefield mid-eruption with lava rivers bursting through cracked ground flowing around combat zone, character standing in center of massive firestorm, burning debris raining from ash-choked sky, enemy positions engulfed in flames with structures collapsing into molten ground
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Malevolent curse energy crawling up captor from point of contact, visible dark tendrils of corruption spreading across their body and position with malignant effect, Ground around captor darkening and dying as curse takes hold, corruption spreading from contact point showing the price of victory, Massive fireball erupting from character engulfing foreground with intense orange light, lava cracking through ground with molten splashes flying up in slow motion, embers and ash swirling in thermal vortex, visible heat distortion waves rippling the air, secondary explosions in background sending shockwaves through smoke
